title: Self-Evolving Training — accelerated experiment replay
source: Captured joint poses, recorded decision probabilities and optimizer snapshots exported from DGX Spark; archived poses rendered on DGX Spark.
presentation: Edited visualization of recorded evidence, with chapter captions and animated plots. This is an accelerated replay, not a live browser recording.
scope: Two selected successful episodes followed by a historical fitting round and its paired evaluation. The RGB-D example is a separate collection run; the second structured-state episode belongs to the displayed training dataset. Selected episodes do not represent an overall success rate.
release_outcome_shown: Validation selected step 25 out of 100 updates. The candidate did not pass all independent release checks, so the current deployment was retained.

playback.inference_waits: Removed; each recorded inference latency remains visible in the decision panel.
playback.training: 100 recorded updates replayed by optimizer step in 12 seconds, followed by one second highlighting the selected checkpoint. This is not uniform wall-clock acceleration.

curves.loss: Raw recorded minibatch cross-entropy at each optimizer step; no smoothing.
curves.step_weight_change: L2 norm of theta_t minus theta_(t-1), over every trainable scorer parameter.
curves.cumulative_weight_change: L2 norm of theta_t minus theta_0, over every trainable scorer parameter.
curves.aggregation: Square root of the sum of squared full-tensor norms, not an estimate from the 64 sampled values.
curves.checkpoint_selection: Step 25 is marked separately; the optimizer trajectory remains visible through step 100.
curves.frozen_encoder: No frozen-parameter version changes were recorded.

editing: Replaced slow live-screen footage with two complete captured-pose replays.
Synchronized action names and probability bars with recorded decision steps.
Re-rendered MuJoCo poses on DGX Spark and applied a uniform 12% brightness increase.
Animated 100 measured loss/weight updates with Matplotlib.
Encoded H.264 with fast-start playback; removed source metadata.
